state:
**Goal `html-later` — Stage 2 is under way: `Core\Html::later` runs on a normal route.** ADR 0266 decides the goal and `rule:core-classes/html-later` is still `designed`. `crates/nvs-runtime/src/later.rs` holds the slots, the one assembly pass `nvs_host::isolate` calls after the frame returns, and the closed head: `fill` sets `Ctx::in_later_slot`, `Ctx::child` copies it, and `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/response.rs`'s `head_open` makes every body member, `setStatus`, `setHeader`, `redirect`, `addCookie` and `Core\Session::regenerate` throw `LogicError` inside a slot. `Ctx::child` now also carries the request's `output_base` and `output_limit`, so a slot or a `Core\Task` child writing past `max_output` fails the request. `crates/nvs-stdlib/tests/html_later.rs` holds all 13 of the stage check's tests, green.

**Known gap, recorded in `later.rs`'s module doc:** slots run when the frame returns, concurrently with each other but not with the main script, because the host seam has no "start a child and return" call. A `later` called inside a `Core\Task::all` child registers on the child's context, and nothing assembles it.

Still owed for the stage: the two `.nvst` cases (one needs the checker to refuse a head change inside a `later` closure at compile time), the rule flip. `docs/reference/lang/80-concurrency.md:10-13` and `docs/spec/02-php-migration.md:862` still need rewriting (goal § Stage 0).

items.text: **The reject case**: `tests/conformance/reject/html-later-closure-cannot-change-the-response-head.nvst` — the checker refuses a `Core\Response` head member or `Core\Session::regenerate` written directly in a closure passed to `Core\Html::later` (`rule:core-classes/html-later`, "a compile error where the checker sees it"); find where `E0801`'s body roster is checked and add a diagnostic code from the `E08xx` band — `crates/nvs-types/src/response.rs:1`.

**The page case**: `tests/conformance/core/html-later-assembles-the-page-in-place-whatever-order-the-slots-finish.nvst` needs a request-mode runner; find how a conformance case runs as an HTTP request (`--REQUEST--` or similar section) — `crates/nvs-test/src/lib.rs:1`.

**Flip `rule:core-classes/html-later` to `shipped`** with `guardedBy` naming `crates/nvs-stdlib/tests/html_later.rs` and the two cases, then `bun nv rules --render` — `docs/rules/core-classes/html-later.md:1`, `crates/nvs-stdlib/tests/html_later.rs:1`.

backlog: A host call that starts a child and returns, so a slot starts while the main script still runs (the goal's "starts `fn` at once") — `crates/nvs-runtime/src/later.rs` module doc.
A `later` registered inside a `Core\Task::all` child is never assembled — `crates/nvs-runtime/src/later.rs` module doc.
`Core\Response\Stream::write` is not guarded by `head_open`; a stream handle passed into a slot could still write — `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/response.rs`.
